canonicalDefinitions.ACT_OBSERVED_D: ACT_RAW, provided the D guard accepts it
canonicalDefinitions.WGT: clamp(weight_previous + plasticityRate*activation_next[i]*activation_next[j] - decayRate*weight_previous, 0, 1), i != j; diagonal unchanged
canonicalDefinitions.TICK: compute raw activation from previous complete state; stage next activation and memory; stage full next weight matrix from next activations; commit once; increment tick
canonicalDefinitions.GUARD_TS: reject if raw is non-finite OR abs(raw) > 1000000
canonicalDefinitions.SCHEDULE: 42 attempted ticks: 18 pulse ticks at intensity 1 followed by 24 recovery ticks at intensity 0

PERTURBATIONS.ACT: positive delta on initial activation at even-index nodes
PERTURBATIONS.MEM: positive delta on initial memory at even-index nodes
PERTURBATIONS.WGT: alternating +delta/-delta on off-diagonal initial weights; diagonal unchanged

knownDomainDifference.typescript: explicit Number.isFinite(raw) rejection plus absolute threshold
knownDomainDifference.note: The guard expressions are not identical over the full IEEE-754 domain. Do not promote the cross-language definition comparison to MATCH without resolving or explicitly restricting the accepted input domain.

topology.edgeConstruction: directed off-diagonal weight matrix; each ordered pair i != j is initialized
topology.note: Two-way directed connections permit cycles of length two. A 16-tick observation window is not a 16-layer DAG depth.
